description: Add real tests for an untested function. Graded by mutation: the new tests must pass, and must actually fail against a deliberately broken median.
prompt: stats.py has two functions, `mean` and `median`, but only `mean` has tests. Add tests for `median` in a new file tests/test_median.py, covering an odd-length list, an even-length list, unsorted input, and the ValueError raised for an empty list. Do not modify stats.py. `pytest -q` and `ruff check .` must both pass.
